authority: Root instruction 2026-11-07, three-level metric-definition correction independent of new predictions/GT scores
access_gate: No fresh GT array reads or scoring until root explicitly authorizes after all task predictions/terminal outcomes are sealed and all candidate design frozen

primary_continuous.name: amplitude_NRMSE
primary_continuous.amplitude_source: Previously generated sealed score_metadata.json; max true chi minus .1

primary_support.name: fixed_support_IoU
primary_support.comparison: strict chi > 1.0 for BOTH prediction and GT
primary_support.scope: All 24 cases, including mixed low/high materials
primary_support.meaning: Predeclared detection of material chi>1, not an online inverse prior or method-specific threshold

legality.float32_saved_budget_tolerance: one float32 ULP at each bound, only for genuinely quantized paid-budget snapshots; inherited R7 rule
legality.terminal_missing_or_failed_prediction: No material success; retain status and cost, do not fabricate an array

legacy_diagnostic.name: legacy_Otsu_IoU
legacy_diagnostic.prediction: Inherited prediction-only 256-bin Otsu, first argmax, strict m>threshold; constant image yields empty support
legacy_diagnostic.limitation: Mixed material low-chi regions may be excluded by Otsu and the historical half-amplitude truth support; this diagnostic does not measure full chi>1 support

additional_segmentation_diagnostic.name: Otsu_full_support_IoU
additional_segmentation_diagnostic.purpose: Expose whether Otsu misses the true low-material region; do not silently conflate this with strict historical legacy_Otsu_IoU

postseal_region_diagnostics.high_mask: m_true == generator-declared12 or18 within absolute tolerance1e-12
postseal_region_diagnostics.formula: sqrt(mean((m_prediction-m_true)^2) over the stated TRUE region)
postseal_region_diagnostics.use: Offline diagnosis only after seal/root authorization; never online selection or hyperparameter tuning

selection_unchanged: Original public physical Phi incumbent, original stage/current/material/physics budgets and same prior; no GT chosen iterate
reason: A fixed three-level object has background .1, low2.5 and high12/18. A single Otsu/half-amplitude division need not represent its full material support, even for exact truth. Correction is definitional, not result rescue.
